extra.WP-35:
Notes from the wave-2 boundary: contract change requests forwarded to this work package, with the lead's decisions. The architecture and wps.json already reflect the decisions; these notes give detail.
- [CR 134 from WP-27] scripts/update-test-suites.sh (WP-27) pins each suite by commit and by the SHA-256 of `git archive`. It vendors test/fixtures/yaml-test-suite/data/<ID>/... from the data-2022-01-17 release, without its name/ and tags/ symlink indexes, and test/fixtures/json-schema-test-suite/data/tests/draft2020-12/ and data/remotes/ at commit 5b0ee16. Each suite directory also gets LICENSE and SOURCE (MIT). The script replaces only data/, LICENSE and SOURCE, so keep test/fixtures/yaml-test-suite/expected-failures.txt (and any JSON skip list) next to data/, never inside it; run `scripts/update-test-suites.sh yaml` (WP-33) or `scripts/update-test-suites.sh json-schema` (WP-35) and commit the output. .gitattributes stores both data/** trees byte for byte (-text, linguist-vendored), so runners must not normalize line endings. The suite's remotes/ files answer http://localhost:1234/ references: WP-35's test runner preloads them as in-memory resources (the production schemaview compiler keeps its refusing loader) or skips refRemote cases with a recorded reason.
- [CR 145 from WP-28] Two schema shapes from WP-28 need clear RZ-CFG-005 messages (01 req 33). (1) A `type` failure at $defs/JSONSchemaDocument (validation.json-schema config.schema), whose `type` is the array [object, boolean]: name every allowed type ('must be an object or a boolean'), and join the types of any type array this way. (2) A `pattern` failure at $defs/OTLP property endpoint (`^https?://[^/?#@\s]+/?$`, 09 req 17): give syntax text, as the Duration and ByteSize messages do, rather than the regex: 'an http or https URL with a host and an optional port, no path other than /, and no user information, query or fragment'. Select that message by schema location (Def "OTLP", property endpoint), not by regex text, and add both cases to the error-mapping goldens. Errors inside the document's own keywords belong to WP-51's offline Check, not to schemaview.
extra.WP-36:
Notes from the wave-2 boundary: contract change requests forwarded to this work package, with the lead's decisions. The architecture and wps.json already reflect the decisions; these notes give detail.
- [CR 144 from WP-28] The rendered schema's $defs/JSONSchemaDocument (validation.json-schema config.schema: type [object, boolean], no properties) is opaque. Detect it through schemaidx: its Node has Def() == "JSONSchemaDocument" (Def follows the $ref), and every position below it is Info.Free with a nil Node. WP-36 overlay: an overlay value at that node replaces the base value whole and never merges recursively (docs/architecture/02-configuration-model.md Overlays table, 'Replaced whole as one atomic value'; 07 req 74). WP-36 subst: string scalars inside are substituted like any other free string (a literal ${ is written $${) and are never re-typed. WP-37: normalize its object keys generically (02 req 18), materialize no defaults inside it, and keep every list inside in authored order (schemaidx ListNone is atomic, 02 req 17). Add tests: an overlay that changes one keyword replaces the whole document, and normalization keeps the order of `enum` and `required`.
- [CR 161 from WP-29] config/overlay treats the value at any position whose schema node is the `JSONSchemaDocument` definition (`validation.json-schema` `config.schema`) as one atomic value: an overlay value replaces it whole and nothing inside it is merged (CM Overlays table row 'Value of the schema's JSONSchemaDocument definition'; 07 req 74). Detect it by definition name through schemaidx: `info.Node.Def() == "JSONSchemaDocument"`, where Node.Def returns the nearest $defs name. No new x-ruralz schema marker is added, because the CM keyword table defines five and the lead does not invent one, so WP-28 and WP-29 need no change. Add an overlay test in which the base and overlay schemas share keys and the result equals the overlay's schema exactly.
